cases.name: Simone Renee Tolliver Austin (RECHECK TO SEE IF COD IS HOMICIDE)
cases.about: Comments on her obituary mentions she was the embodiment of the word “love,” she had been an excellent student, and was in the military, and served her country with a honorable discharge.
cases.narrative:
The victim underwent an autopsy Tuesday, but the Arapahoe County Coroner said it can release no further details about Austin’s death — other than her name and date of birth — under the explanation that “this is an ongoing investigation and requires further testing.” Neither an Arapahoe County Sheriff's spokesperson, nor Caleb Connor, assistant fire chief for Bennett-Watkins Fire Rescue, could confirm how the woman died. The Arapahoe County Sheriff’s Office spokesperson said no further updates were available Tuesday.
“At this time, there are no persons of interest and no suspects,” said Arapahoe County Sheriff's spokesperson Ginger Delgado.
